name: Charles Johnson
summary: An American flyweight (20-9, age 35), 5-4 in his last nine UFC fights. He was knocked out by Alex Perez (R1) and submitted by Asu Almabayev (R3) this year, but beat Bruno Silva (split) and submitted Eduardo Henrique (R3) in August.

how_they_fight.Striking: Long, busy boxer; nine knockouts, spread across R1 to R5.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Opportunistic: four submissions, two of them late.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped twice recently (Perez R1 KO, Almabayev R3 submission); six decision losses.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Goes the distance often and has late finishes (R3, R5).

keys_to_beat: Wrestle and control him; take his back

news.text: Booked against Brandon Moreno at UFC 335.

sources.title: Brandon Moreno Lands Charles Johnson at UFC 335
